text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—This year's summer training camp is over 
too, huh.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Challenging the upcoming Tenno Sho 
(Autumn) and Arima Kinen. To be honest, I 
have no idea how it will turn out.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Still... let's have faith. 'An extreme 
weakness can turn into a strength.'

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Will you hang in there and give it one 
last push with me, Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Alright, it's almost time for the bus to 
arrive! I have to go call everyone!

And so, the intense summer training camp 
with Fuji Kiseki came to an end.
